main.description: One managed Bluesky list: a rule and the app.bsky.graph.list it keeps in step with. Written only by api/graph-lists.js (as dame, with the app password); the cron re-applies every enabled rule every six hours. Holds the last sync's counts, never who joined or left. See docs/GRAPH-LISTS.md.

kind.description: engaged-out: people dame engaged with most. engaged-in: people who engaged with dame most. proximity: accounts close in dame's follow graph.

listUri.description: The curation list this rule drives. Always one this endpoint created.

enabled.description: False pauses the cron for this list; the list stays as it is.

notFollowing.description: Only accounts dame does not follow.

minInteractions.description: Engagement lists: the floor, inside the window.

maxDegree.description: Proximity lists: 1 = people dame follows; 2 = also accounts dame's follows follow.

minVouches.description: Proximity lists: how many of dame's follows must follow a 2nd-degree account.

protects.description: Whether members count as curated for the moderation gate's PROTECTED veto. Off by default.

history.description: The last syncs, newest first: counts only.
